name: Capture metadata probe
description: Synthetic acceptance fixture for API 0.13 capture metadata: level, fixed zoom steps, FOV, tilt, heading and the new photo's stable ID. Shows the raw result.

capabilities.reason: Open the visible native viewfinder with a level and fixed zoom steps; only you can press the shutter.
List this module’s private photos to confirm the captured photo's stable ID.
Required alongside the private photo library.
